newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS-ROMANIAN YOUNG ATHLETE ARRESTED FOR MURDER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ROMANIAN YOUNG ATHLETE ARRESTED FOR MURDER.

text.p: Romanian world junior 2,000 metre hurdles silver medallist Valentin Savu has been arrested on murder charges, police said on Monday.

Savu's coach, Mariana Pandele, said he had left a discotheque on Saturday night and gone to Bucharest's Medical Institute, where he repeatedly punched and kicked a security guard. The man died in hospital a few hours after the attack.

"I cannot understand what happened to him," Pandele said. "He was one of my most serious performers, very quiet and very talented. The only explanation I can see is that he was under the influence of drugs."
Savu, 17, faces up to 15 years in jail if found guilty. Pandele said a lawyer acting on Savu's behalf said he remembered nothing of the attack.
Savu won the silver medal in the 2,000 metre hurdles, a special event for juniors, at this year's world championships in Portugal. REUTER
